d: Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.

Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

The Food team at Careem is at the forefront of transforming how people experience food delivery across the UAE. As part of one of the fastest-growing verticals, we are a dynamic group of professionals driven by innovation, data, and our mission to simplify and improve lives. We work closely with partners, operations, and product teams to ensure seamless, delightful food delivery experiences for our customers.

We are looking for an Account Manager to join our Food - UAE team in Dubai. This role is responsible for owning and nurturing relationships with our restaurant partners to help them grow and succeed on the Careem platform. You will play a critical role in optimizing partner performance, improving operational metrics, and driving strategic initiatives that benefit both Careem and our partners.
q: 2-4 years of experience in account management, partner success, business development, or similar roles, preferably in tech, e-commerce, or F&B sectors.
Proven track record of managing external stakeholders and influencing decision-making.
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data interpretation.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
A problem-solving mindset with a bias for action and continuous improvement.
Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, or a related field.
We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
Work 4 days a week in office & 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.
r: li
Manage a portfolio of restaurant partners, ensuring strong relationships and satisfaction.
li
Drive partners' performance through business reviews, data insights, and strategic recommendations.
li
Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Marketing, and Product teams to execute growth initiatives.
li
Identify and resolve partner concerns swiftly to ensure a high-quality experience.
li
Monitor and analyze partner performance metrics, identifying areas for improvement.
li
Support onboarding and training of new partners to set them up for success.
li
Advocate internally for partner needs and work with relevant teams to drive platform improvements.

d: We are looking for an experienced HR Executive to manage daily HR operations and support a large, diverse workforce across multiple locations. The ideal candidate will have strong people management skills, sound judgment, and the confidence to implement policies and address employee matters professionally.
q: 5–7 years of progressive experience across HR functions.
Proven experience managing HR operations for a large workforce.
Strong knowledge of Oman Labour Law and relevant employment procedures.
Practical experience in HR policy development and implementation.
Strong people management, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.
A confident, assertive, and proactive approach, with the ability to handle sensitive matters professionally.
Ability to manage PRO and Admin teams and follow through on deadlines.
r: li
Manage recruitment, onboarding, employee records, and other HR administration.
li
Monitor attendance, leave, and payroll inputs to ensure accurate and timely processing.
li
Handle employee relations, grievances, and disciplinary matters fairly and consistently.
li
Develop, review, and implement HR policies and procedures.
li
Support performance reviews and follow up on employee improvement plans.
li
Oversee PRO and Admin activities, including employment documentation and renewal schedules.
li
Monitor Omanization requirements and coordinate relevant Ministry of Labour processes.
li
Prepare HR reports and maintain accurate, confidential employee information.
li
Work closely with managers to maintain consistent standards across departments and locations.

d: SITAF Food, a premium food importer and distributor serving the HoReCa and retail sectors, is looking for a Key Account Manager to strengthen its commercial team and develop long-term partnerships with strategic foodservice customers.

The Key Account Manager will manage a portfolio of high-value, structured accounts, each generating at least SAR 8 million in annual revenue. The role involves building relationships with multiple stakeholders and positioning SITAF as a preferred partner within customers’ menu development cycles, procurement processes, and long-term business plans.
q: At least five years of experience in key account management or foodservice sales.
Proven ability to manage strategic accounts and build relationships with multiple senior stakeholders.
Strong understanding of foodservice operations, procurement processes, and menu planning cycles.
Excellent account planning, negotiation, relationship-building, and presentation skills.
Strong financial acumen, with the ability to assess account profitability and prepare reliable sales forecasts.
Ability to coordinate across internal teams and translate account strategies into effective local execution.
Very good English, both written and spoken.
r: li
Build and maintain strong relationships with business owners, procurement teams, corporate chefs, and restaurant chefs.
li
Anticipate menu changes and product requirements, developing tailored solutions that position SITAF as the preferred supply partner.
li
Lead senior-level customer meetings and monthly business reviews, coordinating with the Sales Leadership Team on account performance, opportunities, and action plans.
li
Introduce new products and drive their adoption into customers’ regular purchasing portfolios.
li
Develop and execute strategic account plans with a one- to two-year horizon.
li
Collaborate closely with Field Sales Representatives to ensure consistent execution and service across customer locations.
li
Gather, maintain, and regularly update account and stakeholder information in the customer master database.
li
Prepare and maintain rolling forecasts by account and item, coordinating with internal teams to support product availability and demand planning.
li
Take ownership of receivables follow-up, working closely with customers and Finance to ensure timely collection.

d: Welcome to SLS The Red Sea, where bold creativity and unapologetic luxury come to life.

Part of Ennismore’s globally celebrated lifestyle portfolio, SLS Hotels are known for redefining hospitality through striking design, elevated service, and magnetic social energy. Now open on the Red Sea coast, SLS The Red Sea stands as one of Saudi Arabia’s most exciting lifestyle destinations.

The resort features 150 impeccably designed keys, five dynamic Food & Beverage venues, and a luxurious spa sanctuary, offering guests a seamless blend of indulgence, entertainment, and escape. From vibrant dining experiences to moments of pure relaxation, every detail is crafted to surprise, inspire, and connect.

More than a hotel, SLS The Red Sea is a living stage—a place where creativity thrives, individuality is celebrated, and bold ideas are encouraged. As the journey continues beyond opening, we are building a passionate team to shape the future of this iconic destination. If you’re driven by excellence, energized by lifestyle hospitality, and ready to be part of something extraordinary, this is where your story continues.

At SLS The Red Sea, precision behind the scenes is just as important as the experience we create for our guests. As a Paymaster, you will play a key role in ensuring our team members are paid accurately, on time, and in line with hotel policies and local regulations.

Working closely with the Finance and People & Culture teams, you will manage payroll processing, verify employee data, maintain accurate payroll records, and support smooth month-end payroll operations while handling sensitive information with the highest level of confidentiality.
q: Previous experience as a Paymaster, Payroll Officer, or similar role, preferably within hospitality.
Good knowledge of payroll processing, attendance, leave, overtime, deductions, and employee benefits.
Familiarity with Saudi Labor Law and payroll-related requirements.
Experience with payroll or HR systems such as Oasys, SAP, or Oracle is an advantage.
Strong numerical skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to handle confidential employee and payroll information with discretion.
Ability to meet deadlines and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
r: li
Prepare and process monthly payroll accurately and within established timelines.
li
Calculate and verify salaries, allowances, overtime, deductions, and other payroll adjustments.
li
Review attendance, leave, sick leave, and other payroll-related data before payroll processing.
li
Coordinate closely with People & Culture and department leaders to ensure payroll inputs are complete and accurate.
li
Maintain accurate and confidential employee payroll records and system data.
li
Review new joiners, leavers, transfers, promotions, and salary changes to ensure correct payroll processing.
li
Prepare payroll reports, summaries, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for month-end closing.
li
Ensure payroll practices comply with Saudi labor regulations, company policies, and internal controls.
li
Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies and employee payroll queries in a timely manner.
li
Support Finance with payroll-related journal entries, accruals, and reconciliations.
li
Maintain organized and audit-ready payroll documentation.
li
Handle all employee and payroll information with strict confidentiality and professionalism.
